rag.text:
Test: TC-5727 — SPM - Strategic areas  - Adding strategic theme by Create Strategic Theme button
Priority: Highest | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/TS-519 Strategic Areas
Labels: ppm-e2e-cloud, spm-paulina-tc

Description:
This Test Case can be only exectuted if there are not strategic themes created on the instance yet

Steps:
1. Navigate to Strategic Areas overview
   Expected: Splashscreen "Track your strategic goals in 3 simple steps

Create strategic themeSet objectives and key resultsLink your initiatives" is displayed

Buttons are displayed under the message 

* Create Strategic Theme 
* Go to OKRs

Back to Home and Go to OKR button are displayed in the right-top corner
2. Click on "Create Strategic Theme" button
   Expected: User is directed to Main OKR box with modal to create New Strategic theme

Create and Cancel buttons are displayed at the bottom-right of the modal window
3. Type Strategic Theme name and select period and click Create
   Data: name: TC-5727

period: Y2025
   Expected: Tree view is displayed

Plus button is displayed next to Strategic Theme TC-5727
4. Click on Plus button, select Add sub-objective and click Create
   Data: name: TC-5727 Objective
   Expected: Period is automatically populated as Y2025

TC-5727 Objective is created under Strategic Theme TC-5727
5. Click on Plus button, select Key result and click Create
   Data: name: TC-5727 Key result
   Expected: Period is automatically populated as Y2025

TC-5727 Key result is created under  TC-5727 Objective
6. Click on Finish & go back
   Expected: Modal is closed

Strategic Theme TC-5727 is displayed on the list with its children

Following columns are displayed on the left

* OKR Overview
* OKR Hierarchy
* Progress Dashboard
* Strategic Areas
* Settings
7. Click on Strategic Areas
   Expected: *Strategic theme* TC-5727 is displayed
